betterquesting:10.desc:8:
The §6Molecular Assembler §fis where autocrafting actually happens. Without at least one, your patterns are just instructions gathering dust.

When a crafting job is requested, the Molecular Assembler picks up the pattern and executes it. It holds 9 intermediate items internally during multi-step crafts. Place multiple assemblers on a single Crafting CPU for parallel job execution.

Craft it from Iron, Quartz Glass, an Annihilation Core, a Crafting Table, and a Formation Core. It has 5 upgrade slots for Acceleration Cards, each adding 50% speed.

§9Note:§f A bare Molecular Assembler does not open a Crafting Terminal. Place a Pattern Terminal on it to drive crafting.

§ePS:§f Power draw scales with crafting complexity. Keep your energy cells charged during big jobs.
